verdict.rationale: Evidence for this story is thin. A hands-on community report says a timed email can be set up in SFDC within minutes, and the marketing docs claim 'engagement built directly into your CRM' and 'Built-in Sales Flows', which suggests in-CRM outbound email automation. No evidence explicitly documents email templates or multi-step prospect sequences. missing for 10: first-party documentation of email templates, multi-step/cadence sequence builder, sending to prospects from records, independent corroboration of sequences
